correctness.rationale: For any chain block partition, its weighted averaging Jacobian preserves constants. The path step basis yields its exact weighted edge-variation norm. Each step crossing a block gives the interpolation ratio for the two exterior edges; every consecutive block is realized with strict positive KKT multipliers, so all upper-bound terms are attained. Finite continuous piecewise-linearity gives the global upper bound. Upper concave hull and slope inequalities are elementary convex-hull consequences. The standalone exact-rational checker independently enumerated 54 complete partition problems and 1,134 active-block witnesses for n=2,...,7. The proof, not finite checks, covers arbitrary n and arbitrary positive real parameters.

originality.rationale: A close qualitative antecedent is Yang–Barber (2017), whose unweighted-observation NUNA theorem implies the equal-mass contraction criterion; no originality is claimed for that special case alone. The full quantitative independent-mass/edge-weight formula, all chord attainments, and O(n) mass-coordinate concavification are not covered by the inspected primary weighted-PAV, generalized NUNA, or graph-poset sources. The 2009 paper gives PAV means, not this norm. The accessible prior tree result handles uniform weights. Residual unindexed/implicit equivalence risk is noted.
residual_risks: General 2017 NUNA theorem subsumes the qualitative equal-observation-mass boundary; it could facilitate a short independent derivation of that special case.
Earlier weighted PAV sources might contain an implicit seminorm corollary not indexed under graph-variation terminology.
2009 JSS weighted-PAV paper full PDF was not inspected; its abstract establishes an algorithmic aim, but not whole-document noncoverage.
Novelty cannot be established by database partition, negative search, or title matching alone.

value.rationale: The exact, attained perturbation constant is a natural stability invariant of weighted PAV under spatially varying uncertainty and edge-penalty choices. It provides a complete mass-aware nonexpansivity classification, a linear-time concave-envelope algorithm, and an explicit mass-reweighting example changing amplification from 5/2 to 1 while leaving the variation weights fixed. These structural effects are not routine a priori consequences of one-input variation or weighted least-squares nonexpansivity.
